scope: Paired decode-only comparison on one bundled playback proxy. No inference, accuracy, multi-camera, or browser playback claim.

conditions.method_order: Alternated seek-first and forward-first by round
conditions.timed_region: OpenCV cursor checks and seek/grab/retrieve/read calls; pixel hashing was outside the timed interval

limitations: One bundled proxy and one local host; not a controlled multi-host study.
No model inference, frontend interaction, native playback frame-loss, or six-camera load was measured.
This result does not establish plate detection or OCR accuracy.
